Inputs shared by the QC functions

Source: R/qc.R
qc_inputs.Rd

The qc_* functions check the quality of pooled CRISPR screen count data. Rather than parsing sample names, they are driven by two tables: a count matrix (counts) and a sample table (meta). The same functions therefore work for screens with different designs.

Arguments

counts

Count matrix: data frame with columns sgRNA, Gene and one column of raw counts per sample (see section 'Count matrix').

meta

Sample table: data frame with one row per sample and columns sample_id, label, group and replicate (see section 'Sample table'). Only samples in meta are used.

ctrl_pattern

Regular expression matched against the Gene column to identify control sgRNAs (default is "NEG_CTRL", which matches the controls of all libraries shipped with crisprFlow).

summary_df

Count summary: data frame with columns sample_id, total_reads and mapped (see section 'Count summary').

colour_by

Name of the column in meta used to colour samples.

colours

Optional named character vector of colours, with names matching the values of the colour_by column (e.g. c(Untreated = "#0073C2", Drug = "#CD534C")). If NULL (default), the RColorBrewer "Dark2" palette is used.

facet_by

Optional name of a column in meta used to split the plot into panels (default is NULL, no panels).

interactive

Logical; if TRUE (default), return an interactive plotly object, otherwise a ggplot object.

base_size

Base font size of the plot.

Count matrix (counts)

A data frame with one row per sgRNA and the columns

sgRNA

sgRNA identifier

Gene

gene targeted by the sgRNA (control sgRNAs carry a gene name matching ctrl_pattern, e.g. NONE_TARGETING_NEG_CTRL or CTRLA_NEG_CTRL)

<sample_id>

one column of raw (non-normalized) read counts per sample

This is the layout written by MAGeCK and guide-counter, see qc_read_counts and qc_read_count_dir.

Sample table (meta)

A data frame with one row per sample. The row order sets the order in which samples are shown in plots. Required columns:

sample_id

name of the sample's column in counts

label

short, unique display label for the sample

group

biological group / condition (preferably a factor, whose levels then set the order of groups)

replicate

replicate identifier (character)

Any further columns (e.g. cell_line, day) can be used for colouring, faceting or point shapes through the colour_by, facet_by and shape_by arguments. Use qc_check_meta to check a sample table against a count matrix.

Count summary (summary_df)

A data frame with one row per sample, with at least the columns sample_id, total_reads (sequenced reads) and mapped (reads assigned to a library sgRNA), as returned by qc_read_count_summary and qc_read_summary_dir.

Font

Plots use the font family set by the option crisprFlow.font (default "sans"), e.g. options(crisprFlow.font = "Arial").

Examples

## Simulated screen shipped with crisprFlow
head(exampleCounts)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 12
#>   sgRNA  Gene  Plasmid  T0_1  T0_2  T0_3 Untreated_1 Untreated_2 Untreated_3
#>   <chr>  <chr>   <int> <int> <int> <int>       <int>       <int>       <int>
#> 1 AAK1_1 AAK1      227   192   236   201         193         227         412
#> 2 AAK1_2 AAK1      299   251   261   336         220         353         270
#> 3 AAK1_3 AAK1      224   125   146   185         164         194         219
#> 4 AAK1_4 AAK1      548   479   430   703         557         544         376
#> 5 AAK1_5 AAK1      183   201   158   171         221         267         152
#> 6 ABL2_1 ABL2      658   434   481   551         786         724         773
#> # ℹ 3 more variables: Drug_1 <int>, Drug_2 <int>, Drug_3 <int>
exampleSampleMeta
#> # A tibble: 10 × 5
#>    sample_id   label       group     replicate   day
#>    <chr>       <chr>       <fct>     <chr>     <int>
#>  1 Plasmid     Plasmid     Plasmid   1             0
#>  2 T0_1        T0_1        T0        1             2
#>  3 T0_2        T0_2        T0        2             2
#>  4 T0_3        T0_3        T0        3             2
#>  5 Untreated_1 Untreated_1 Untreated 1             9
#>  6 Untreated_2 Untreated_2 Untreated 2             9
#>  7 Untreated_3 Untreated_3 Untreated 3             9
#>  8 Drug_1      Drug_1      Drug      1             9
#>  9 Drug_2      Drug_2      Drug      2             9
#> 10 Drug_3      Drug_3      Drug      3             9
qc_check_meta(exampleSampleMeta, exampleCounts)
